name: China (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the China town emblem in navy: an outlined disc enclosing the characters 知名 with a stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of China, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 23 June 1956.

features.role: China town emblem — an outlined disc enclosing the characters 知名 with a stylised device
